# SCP-173 "The Sculpture"
This guide explains what the object is within the game and how its mechanics work. It does NOT cover the object's lore.
This page is a collection of links to other, more detailed guides about the object, together with a brief description of each section.
## Start of the Round
At its starting point, at the beginning of the round, or after spawning, SCP-173 is inside its containment chamber. The containment chamber is a restraining measure that prevents the object from harming complex personnel.
As long as the object remains inside, it poses almost no threat.
- The task of complex personnel is to keep the object inside the containment chamber. - SCP-173's task is to leave the containment chamber.
[textlink="More about containment here" link="Scp173Containment"]
[textlink="More about escape methods here" link="Scp173ContainmentBreach"]
## Abilities
The Sculpture has several unique abilities, two of which are key mechanics that allow it to escape the containment chamber.
